archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
summary: The starter deck lacks boss damage. Take efficient attacks first, then sustained scaling and stronger defense. Use Boots for valuable rooms or avoiding dangerous fights; fight elites only when prepared.

archetype: Efficient damage into sustained poison and dexterity defense
summary: Heal at the first fire. Current boss damage is inadequate: prioritize efficient attacks and sustained poison. Upgrade damage when safe; avoid early elites and attempt the late elite only with healthy HP and potions.
